text: For the leader. A psalm of the Korahites.
I All you peoples, clap your hands;shout to God with joyful cries. [AA]
For the Lord, the Most High, is to be feared,the great king over all the earth, [AB]
Who made people subject to us,nations under our feet, [AC]
t[1]Who chose our heritage for us,the glory of Jacob, whom he loves. [AD]Selah
II [2]God has gone up with a shout;the Lord, amid trumpet blasts. [AE]
Sing praise to God, sing praise;sing praise to our king, sing praise.
III For God is king over all the earth; [AF]sing hymns of praise.
God rules over the nations;God sits upon his holy throne.
The princes of the peoples assemblewith the people of the God of Abraham.For the shields of the earth belong to God,highly exalted. [AG]
